name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow or Claude Code's own task list, with the current activity, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

terminalCrabs.title: Terminal crabs
terminalCrabs.description: auto: pixel sprites in terminals that show images (kitty, Ghostty), quadrant-block Clawd elsewhere; pixels or cells to choose one

taskList.title: Task list bar
taskList.description: nudge: mirror Claude Code's own task list in the bar when no flow is reported, and remind Claude when the list goes stale; mirror: the bar only; off: neither
